# Zsolution

> Zsolution, run by Ibrahim Zid in Cairo: websites for restaurants and hotels, photographers and videographers, and yoga and fitness coaches. Restaurant and hotel website design, restaurant and hotel SEO and AI answers, hotel marketing that starts with your own site, GA4 setup, menu and food-cost review. Background: five years as a chef and two as operations manager in Maldives hotels. Based in Cairo, works worldwide.

## Offer
- Restaurant and hotel website design: one-page site from $99, first 5 clients $79. Full multi-page site priced after the free first concept. For hotels, the base of hotel marketing.
- Menu and food-cost review, from $49 (first 5 clients $39). SEO and AI-answer setup from $79. Speed fixes and GA4 tracking setup from $59 each.
- Full audit (SEO, AI answers, speed, tracking): price agreed first, credited if the project continues
- For photographers, videographers and yoga or fitness coaches: one bundle with a one-page site, GA4 tracking, SEO and AI-answer content and 5 social posts. From $99, final price after the free first concept.
- Free first concept: one real page you open on your phone, no charge. For the first 5 clients, the first project is 20% off, open for 7 days from the day you message.
- Prices are shown in the local currency of the visitor's country on the site (EGP, SAR, AED, QAR, KWD, BHD, OMR), USD elsewhere.
